item.title: Japan's Takaiichi pushes for Andong visit on 19th (日 다카이치, 19일 안동 방문 추진)
item.description:
Japan's Takaiichi pushes for Andong visit on 19th (日 다카이치, 19일 안동 방문 추진)

Japanese Prime Minister Takaiichi Sanae will visit South Korea this month as part of shuttle diplomacy between the two countries. According to multiple Japanese diplomatic sources on the 8th, Takaiichi is coordinating a schedule to visit Andong, Gyeongbuk, the hometown of President Lee Jae-myung, on the 19th-20th for a summit. If the meeting materializes, it will be the third encounter between President Lee and Prime Minister Takaiichi. The two first met at the APEC summit in Gyeongju last October, and in January this year, President Lee visited Nara Prefecture, Takaiichi’s hometown. (다카이치 사나에 일본 총리가 이달 넷째 주 한일 셔틀 외교 일환으로 한국을 방문한다. 8일 복수의 일본 외교 소식통에 따르면, 다카이치 총리는 19~20일 이재명 대통령의 고향인 경북 안동을 방문해 정상회담을 갖는 일정을 조율 중이다. 회담이 성사되면 이 대통령과 다카이치 총리의 세 번째 만남이 된다. 두 사람은 지난해 10월 경주 APEC 회의에서 처음 만났고, 올해 1월엔 이 대통령이 다카이치 총리의 고향인 나라현을 방문했다.)

The upcoming summit is expected to continue fostering personal ties between the leaders while discussing supply chain issues due to the blockade of the Strait of Hormuz, North Korea's nuclear and missile problems, and other Northeast Asian security situations. Strengthening security cooperation between South Korea and Japan in response to U.S. demands for allies to share defense burdens is likely to be a key agenda item. The outcome of the U.S.-China summit (14th-15th) is also expected to be discussed. (이번 회담에선 정상 간 친분을 이어가면서 호르무즈 해협 봉쇄로 인한 공급망 문제, 북한의 핵·미사일 문제 등 동북아 정세를 논의할 예정이다. 동맹들에 방위 분담을 요구하는 미국에 대응해 한일 간 안보 협력을 강화하는 방안도 주요 의제가 될 것으로 보인다. 미중 정상회담(14~15일) 결과도 논의될 전망이다.)

Meanwhile, President Lee spoke by phone with Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney on the 8th, agreeing to closely cooperate on guaranteeing freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz and ensuring stable energy supply amid the energy and supply chain crisis caused by the Middle East war. (한편 이 대통령은 8일 마크 카니 캐나다 총리와 통화하고, 중동 전쟁으로 인한 에너지·공급망 위기에서 호르무즈 해협 항행의 자유 보장, 안정적 에너지 수급을 위해 긴밀히 협력해 나가기로 했다.)

The phone call between the leaders came as a consortium of Hanwha Ocean and HD Hyundai Heavy Industries competes with Germany's TKMS for a contract worth up to 60 trillion won under Canada's "Canadian Patrol Submarine Project (CPSP)." The results of the bidding are expected as early as the end of next month. A Cheong Wa Dae official said, "Given the enormous scale of the project and intense government-level competition, President Lee lent his support." Earlier, Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik visited Canada in January as a special envoy for strategic economic cooperation, and Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy Kim Jeong-gwan visited Canada on the 5th-6th (local time) to meet with relevant ministry officials. (이날 정상 간 통화는 캐나다가 추진하는 최대 60조원 규모 ‘캐나다 초계 잠수함 프로젝트(CPSP)’ 수주를 놓고 한화오션·HD현대중공업 컨소시엄이 독일 TKMS와 경쟁 중인 가운데 이뤄졌다. 수주전 결과는 이르면 다음 달 말 나올 예정이다. 청와대 관계자는 “워낙 규모가 큰 사업이고 정부 차원의 경쟁도 치열한 상황이어서 이 대통령이 힘을 보탠 것”이라고 했다. 앞서 강훈식 비서실장도 지난 1월 전략경제협력 대통령 특사 자격으로 캐나다를 방문했고, 김정관 산업통상부 장관은 지난 5~6일(현지 시각) 캐나다를 찾아 관계 부처 장관 등을 만났다.)

item.title: Seoul, Now Wrangling over Yongsan Development… Jung Won-oh: “Supply 10,000 Units” Oh Se-hoon: “Are You Creating a Chicken Coop?” (서울, 이번엔 용산 개발 공방… 정원오 “1만호 공급” 오세훈 “닭장촌 만듭니까”)
item.description:
Seoul, Now Wrangling over Yongsan Development… Jung Won-oh: “Supply 10,000 Units” Oh Se-hoon: “Are You Creating a Chicken Coop?” (서울, 이번엔 용산 개발 공방… 정원오 “1만호 공급” 오세훈 “닭장촌 만듭니까”)

As real estate policy emerges as a key issue in the Seoul mayoral election, rival candidates clashed on the 8th over the Yongsan development issue. Regarding the development of the Yongsan International Business District, which has sparked controversy over "overcrowding" after the government announced plans to supply 10,000 housing units earlier this year, Democratic Party candidate Jung Won-oh said, "Whether it's 10,000 units or 8,000 units is ultimately a matter of adjustment." However, People Power Party candidate Oh Se-hoon countered, "Are you trying to build chicken coop apartments?" and demanded, "Withdraw the 10,000-unit pledge immediately." Yongsan District is an area where the People Power Party won in the last general and presidential elections. <<> Candidate Jung held a press conference at the Yongsan Maintenance Depot site, slated for development into an international business district, stating, "The maintenance depot site has been neglected for over 15 years due to the failure of Oh Se-hoon-style development," and proposed, "I will attract a UN AI (Artificial Intelligence) Hub to Yongsan." Regarding housing supply, he added, "If the government and Seoul city coordinate, we can find a consensus that benefits all citizens." <<> In May 2020, the government initially announced plans to supply 8,000 housing units in the Yongsan International Business District, but increased that to 10,000 units in August of the same year. Seoul city opposed this, citing insufficient schools, roads, and green spaces, and in 2022 agreed to develop 6,000 units. However, controversy reignited when the Yoon Suk-yeol administration announced plans again in January for 10,000 units. <<> Candidate Oh also posted on Facebook that day, saying, "The Yongsan International Business District is a strategic hub that should serve as the 'face of Seoul,'" and "Candidate Jung, who wants to reduce such a place to a chicken coop apartment complex, is shattering Seoul's future." He added, "The optimal housing supply is 6,000 units, and the agreed amount is 8,000 units—that number is the bottom line." <<> The two candidates also engaged in a war of nerves over redevelopment and reconstruction pledges. Candidate Oh announced a pledge the previous day to shorten the redevelopment period, but Candidate Jung's camp claimed this was a copy of Oh’s "Step-by-Step Development" pledge, which strengthens district autonomy to speed up redevelopment and reconstruction. In response, Candidate Oh said he had already pioneered the "Smart Planning" policy to support swift redevelopment projects, calling Jung's claim "exactly like a new restaurant opening next to a long-established galbi-tang (beef rib soup) shop and claiming it’s the original." (서울시장 선거에서 부동산 정책이 쟁점으로 떠오른 가운데 여야 후보들은 8일 용산 개발 문제를 놓고 충돌했다. 올 들어 정부가 주택 1만 가구 공급 계획을 발표해 ‘과밀화’ 논란이 있었던 용산국제업무지구 개발에 대해 더불어민주당 정원오 후보는 “1만호냐, 8000호냐는 결국 조정의 문제”라고 했다. 하지만 국민의힘 오세훈 후보는 “닭장 아파트를 만들겠다는 거냐”며 “당장 1만호 공약을 철회하라”고 했다. 용산구는 지난 총선과 대선에서 국민의힘이 승리한 지역이다.)

item.title: "Speed Over Bipartisanship" and "We Could Take All Committees" — National Assembly Speaker Candidates Abandon Neutrality for Party Loyalty (“협치보다 속도” “상임위 다 가질 수도”… 국회의장 후보들, 중립 내던지고 ‘당원 코드’)
item.description:
"Speed Over Bipartisanship" and "We Could Take All Committees" — National Assembly Speaker Candidates Abandon Neutrality for Party Loyalty (“협치보다 속도” “상임위 다 가질 수도”… 국회의장 후보들, 중립 내던지고 ‘당원 코드’)

Candidates from the Democratic Party of Korea vying for the position of National Assembly Speaker in the second half of the 22nd term—Cho Jung-sik (6th term), Park Ji-won (5th term), and Kim Tae-nyeon (5th term)—are engaging in a "show of distinctiveness" competition, mindful of hardline party members. Political observers note, "The National Assembly Speaker is supposed to be a politically neutral position without a party affiliation, but its significance is fading." (22대 후반기 국회의장 선거에 나선 더불어민주당 조정식(6선)·박지원(5선)· 김태년(5선) 의원이 강성 당원을 의식한 ‘선명성 경쟁’을 벌이고 있다. 정치권에서는 “국회의장은 당적을 갖지 않으면서 정치적 중립을 지켜야 하는 자리인데 그 의미가 퇴색되고 있다”는 지적이 나왔다.)

Since the Democratic Party holds a majority in the National Assembly, the winner of its internal primary will once again become the Speaker. Notably, this time, the voting ratio has been adjusted to 80% by lawmakers and 20% by party members for the first time. This has led to "pledges" tailored to appeal to hardline party members. (민주당이 국회 과반 의석을 가지고 있기 때문에, 이번에도 민주당 내부 경선에서 이긴 의원이 국회의장이 된다. 특히 이번에는 처음으로 의원 투표 비율을 80%로 줄이고 당원 투표를 20% 반영한다. 이 때문에 강성 당원을 의식한 ‘공약’들이 나오고 있다.)

In a Yonhap News interview released on the 8th, Rep. Cho Jung-sik stated, "The National Assembly Speaker, as a former ruling party member, should align with the government," adding, "Speed is more important than bipartisanship." He also proposed setting a deadline for negotiating the allocation of standing committees in the second half, and if the ruling and opposition parties fail to reach an agreement, the Democratic Party would take over all committees. (조정식 의원은 8일 공개된 연합뉴스 인터뷰에서 “국회의장은 여당 출신으로서 정부와 손발을 맞춰야 한다”며 “협치보다 속도가 중요하다”고 했다. 후반기 상임위 배분 협상은 기한을 정해두고 하고, 여야가 합의에 이르지 못하면 민주당이 전 상임위를 다 갖도록 하겠다고도 했다.)

On the same day, Rep. Kim Tae-nyeon appeared on Kim Ou-joon's YouTube channel and said, "I've proposed a bill that if a standing committee chair refuses to convene meetings, a secretary from another negotiating group can act as the chair and call meetings, and the chair can be replaced by a majority vote of committee members." This is aimed at allowing the Democratic Party to seize the chairmanship if the People Power Party's committee chairs block the unilateral processing of bills by refusing to hold meetings. (김태년 의원은 이날 김어준씨 유튜브에 출연해 “상임위원장이 회의를 열지 않으면 다른 교섭단체 소속 간사가 위원장 직무대행이 돼 회의를 열 수 있게 하고, 해당 상임위 위원 과반 찬성으로 위원장을 교체할 수 있는 법안을 발의해 놨다”고 했다. 국민의힘 상임위원장이 회의를 열지 않는 방식으로 법안 일방 처리를 저지하면 민주당이 위원장 자리를 뺏을 수 있게 하겠다는 것이다.)

Political insiders remarked, "This is the first time we've seen people aspiring to be National Assembly Speaker hint at 'one-sided parliamentary operations.'" Rep. Park Ji-won wrote on Facebook, "I want to create a National Assembly that supports the success of the Lee Jae-myung government." He also said, "When public sentiment, party sentiment, and lawmakers' sentiment (the hearts of Democratic Party lawmakers) align, it becomes clear sentiment." (이를 두고 정치권 인사들은 “국회의장이 되겠다는 사람들이 ‘국회 일방 운영’을 예고하는 것은 처음 본다”고 했다. 박지원 의원은 페이스북 글을 통해 “이재명 정부 성공을 지원하는 국회를 만들고 싶다”고 했다. 그는 “민심, 당심, 의심(議心·민주당 의원들의 마음)이 하나가 되면 명심(明心)”이라고 했다.)

There is widespread anticipation that party member voting will be a key variable in this primary. With 152 Democratic Party lawmakers participating in the vote—though some may be absent due to local election campaigns—party member votes, when converted into lawmaker equivalents, amount to 38. In a survey conducted from the 2nd to the 4th by Straight News and Jo Won C&I, among Democratic Party supporters, Rep. Park garnered 52.2%, Rep. Cho 13.7%, and Rep. Kim 7.6%. Another survey by Cheonji Ilbo and Korea Information Research from the 27th to the 28th of last month showed 45.5% of Democratic Party supporters favoring Rep. Park, with Rep. Cho at 9.5% and Rep. Kim at 6.3%. (이번 경선에서 당원 투표가 변수가 될 것이란 전망이 지배적이다. 지방선거 출마 등으로 민주당 의원 152명이 투표에 참여하는데, 당원 투표를 의원으로 환산하면 38명에 이른다. 스트레이트뉴스·조원씨앤아이의 지난 2~4일 조사에서는 민주당 지지층에서 박 의원 52.2%, 조 의원 13.7%, 김 의원 7.6%로 나왔다. 천지일보·코리아정보리서치의 지난달 27~28일 조사에서도 민주당 지지층의 45.5%는 박 의원 지지였다. 조 의원은 9.5%, 김 의원은 6.3%였다.)

However, among lawmaker votes, there are reports that Rep. Cho, who recently served as President Lee's special adviser on political affairs, is receiving support from the pro-Lee faction. (반면, 의원 투표에서는 최근까지 이 대통령의 정무특보를 지낸 조 의원이 친명계의 지원을 받고 있다는 얘기가 나온다.)

item.title: Ruling Party's Pursuit of Constitutional Amendment Ultimately Fails (여당이 추진한 개헌 결국 무산)
item.description:
Ruling Party's Pursuit of Constitutional Amendment Ultimately Fails (여당이 추진한 개헌 결국 무산)

The constitutional amendment pushed forward by the Democratic Party of Korea without agreement from the People Power Party ultimately failed on the 8th. The amendment, pursued for the first time in 39 years since 1987, will now see its discussion postponed until after the local elections. (더불어민주당이 국민의힘과 합의 없이 밀어붙였던 개헌이 8일 결국 무산됐다. 1987년 이후 39년 만에 추진됐던 개헌은 지방선거 이후로 논의가 미뤄지게 됐다.)

National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik declared the suspension of the constitutional amendment process during a plenary session, stating, "As of today, the related procedures have been halted." The previous day, Woo had submitted the amendment to the plenary session with the aim of holding a national referendum concurrently with the June 3 local elections, but the People Power Party boycotted, citing opposition to a unilateral push. He then declared "vote failure due to insufficient quorum" and attempted a revote today. The People Power Party had been advocating for the amendment to be pursued after the local elections. (우원식 국회의장은 이날 국회 본회의에서 “오늘로써 (개헌) 관련 절차는 중단됐다”며 개헌안 처리 중단을 선언했다. 우 의장은 전날 6·3 지방선거와 동시에 국민투표에 부치려던 개헌안을 본회의에 상정했지만 국민의힘이 “일방적 추진에 반대한다”며 불참했다. 그러자 ‘의결정족수 부족에 따른 투표 불성립’을 선포하고 이날 재투표하려 했다. 국민의힘은 지방선거 이후 개헌을 추진하자고 해왔다.)

Following the failure of the amendment, Speaker Woo stated, "I cannot help but express strong regret toward the People Power Party, which brought political tactics and unreasonable arguments to scuttle the constitutional amendment." Democratic Party Spokesperson Lee Ju-hee said, "The People Power Party has openly admitted to being an accomplice to the insurrectionist forces." Senior Presidential Secretary Kang Yoo-jung expressed regret over the failure of the amendment, stating, "The people will find it hard to understand the reasons for opposing even a minimal constitutional amendment meant to safeguard the nation's security and democracy." (개헌안 처리가 무산되자 우 의장은 “정략과 억지 주장을 끌어들여 개헌을 무산시킨 국민의힘에 강력한 유감을 표명하지 않을 수 없다”고 했다. 민주당 이주희 원내대변인은 “국민의힘은 스스로 내란 세력의 공범임을 만천하에 자인했다”고 했다. 청와대 강유정 수석대변인은 개헌안 처리 무산에 대해 유감을 표하면서 “국민들은 국가의 안위와 민주주의를 지키기 위한 최소한의 개헌마저 반대한 이유를 납득하기 어려우실 것”이라고 했다.)

The People Power Party said they would block any constitutional amendment lacking bipartisan agreement. Floor Leader Song Un-sok stated, "Extractive amendments, shoddy amendments, third-term amendments, and even the Yushin Constitution—all pursued without opposition consent—ended in dictatorship and misfortune." (국민의힘은 여야 합의 없는 개헌은 막겠다고 했다. 송언석 원내대표는 “(야당 반대에도 강행된) 발췌 개헌, 사사오입 개헌, 3선 개헌, 유신헌법까지 결말은 모두 독재와 불행으로 점철됐다”고 했다.)

◇ Revote pursued without consultation with opposition… abandoned after public opinion worsened (◇野와 협의도 없이 재투표 추진… 여론 나빠지자 포기)

Although the vote on the constitutional amendment failed due to the People Power Party's boycott on the 7th, Speaker Woo Won-shik and the Democratic Party maintained until the morning of the 8th that they would process the amendment that day. However, after the People Power Party announced a filibuster on all bills, including the amendment, Woo suspended its processing. Addressing the People Power Party, Speaker Woo said, "Can you escape the suspicion that you haven't severed ties with former President Yoon Suk-yeol, even by filibustering an amendment that would prevent you from even dreaming of an illegal martial law?" Woo, who criticized the People Power Party for 20 minutes from the chair, shed tears during his speech and struck the gavel angrily when declaring the session adjourned. (지난 7일 국민의힘의 불참으로 개헌안 투표가 불성립됐지만 8일 오전까지도 우원식 국회의장과 더불어민주당은 이날 개헌안을 처리하겠다고 했다. 하지만 국민의힘이 개헌안을 비롯한 모든 법안에 대해 필리버스터(무제한 토론)를 예고하자 우 의장은 개헌안 처리를 중단했다. 우 의장은 국민의힘을 향해 “불법 계엄을 꿈도 못 꾸게 하는 개헌에 필리버스터까지 걸면서 윤석열 전 대통령과 절연하지 못했다는 의심에서 벗어날 수 있겠느냐”고 했다. 의장석에서 20분간 국민의힘을 비판한 우 의장은 발언 도중 눈물을 보였고, 산회를 선언할 때는 화가 난 듯 의사봉을 내리치기도 했다.)

As Woo spoke, lawmakers from both parties exchanged shouts in the plenary hall. Democratic Party lawmakers called the People Power Party the "party of insurrection," while the People Power Party retorted by calling the Democratic Party the "unconstitutional party." Democratic Party Floor Leader Park Chan-dae told reporters after the session, "What does strengthening parliamentary oversight to prevent insurrection and martial law, and mandating balanced national development, have to do with elections? The People Power Party will surely face judgment from the people." People Power Party Floor Leader Song Un-sok stated, "The end result of a constitutional amendment without bipartisan agreement is dictatorship." (우 의장이 발언하는 동안 여야 의원들은 본회의장에서 고성을 주고받았다. 민주당 의원들은 국민의힘 의원들을 향해 “내란 정당”이라고 했고, 국민의힘은 민주당을 향해 “위헌 정당”이라고 맞받았다. 한병도 민주당 원내대표는 본회의 직후 기자들과 만나 “내란이, 계엄이 다시는 일어나지 않도록 엄격하게 국회 통제권을 강화하고 국가 균형 발전을 의무화하는 게 선거와 무슨 관련이 있느냐”며 “(국민의힘은) 국민들로부터 심판을 분명히 받을 것”이라고 했다. 송언석 국민의힘 원내대표는 “여야 합의 없는 개헌의 결말은 독재”라고 했다.)

Although the amendment's passage was already difficult due to the People Power Party's early decision to oppose it as party policy, Speaker Woo maintained his position to hold plenary sessions and proceed with the vote on the 7th and 8th. Within the Democratic Party, some mentioned, "If it fails on the 8th, we are considering additional sessions on the 9th and 10th." To hold a national referendum on the amendment during the June 3 local elections, the amendment needed to pass the National Assembly by the 10th. Before the plenary session, President Lee Jae-myung and the Democratic Party leadership criticized the People Power Party, which insisted on postponing the amendment until after the local elections and opposed its processing, by questioning, "Aren't you colluding with the insurrection?" There were also criticisms that the push for the amendment right before the local elections, while simultaneously pursuing a 'fabricated indictment' special counsel law that could dismiss President Lee's case, was an attempt to divert public attention after public opinion turned negative. (국민의힘이 일찌감치 당론으로 반대해 개헌안 통과가 어려운 상황이었지만 우 의장은 7일에 이어 8일에도 본회의를 열고 개헌안 투표를 하겠다는 입장이었다. 민주당에서는 “8일에 안 되면 9일, 10일 본회의도 검토하고 있다”는 말도 나왔다. 6·3 지방선거 때 개헌 국민투표를 하려면 10일까지는 개헌안이 국회를 통과해야 한다. 본회의에 앞서 이재명 대통령과 민주당 지도부는 지방선거 이후 개헌을 주장하며 개헌안 처리를 반대하는 국민의힘을 향해 “내란 동조 세력이 아니냐”는 취지로 비판했다. 지방선거 직전 개헌을 밀어붙이면서 이 대통령 사건을 공소 취소할 수 있는 ‘조작 기소’ 특검법을 추진했다가 여론이 악화되자 개헌으로 희석시키려는 게 아니냐는 지적까지 받기도 했다.)

Ultimately, with public opinion rising that "pushing through major national matters like a constitutional amendment without the consent of the main opposition party could lead to greater social chaos," the processing of the amendment was halted. Some in political circles remarked, "Wasn't it obvious they couldn't persuade the People Power Party? They pushed a hasty, election-oriented constitutional amendment show, and when public opinion worsened, they quietly folded while blaming the opposition." The People Power Party criticized, "Did Speaker Woo suddenly reverse his announced plan to resubmit the amendment because of his overseas travel schedule?" (결국 “개헌과 같은 국가 대사를 제1 야당의 합의 없이 밀어붙일 경우 사회적 혼란이 더 커질 수 있다”는 여론이 비등하면서 개헌안 처리는 중단됐다. 정치권에선 “국민의힘을 설득하지 못하는 걸 뻔히 알면서 선거용 졸속 개헌 쇼를 추진하다 여론이 악화되자 야당 탓을 하며 슬그머니 접은 것 아니냐”는 말도 나왔다. 국민의힘은 이날 “개헌안 재상정을 예고했던 우 의장이 갑자기 방침을 뒤집은 건 해외 순방 일정 때문 아니냐”고 비판했다.)

Speaker Woo, whose term as National Assembly Speaker ends on the 29th, is scheduled to embark on a roughly week-long trip to the Netherlands and Kenya starting the 10th. People Power Party Senior Spokesperson Choi Soo-jin said, "Is it because Speaker Woo needs to go on his 'Speaker's graduation trip' that he couldn't put the agenda item on the schedule?" Another Senior Spokesperson, Park Choong-kwon, added, "Since he scuttled the filibuster, (Speaker Woo) should enjoy his final overseas trip with a peace of mind." National Assembly Secretary General Cho O-seop, in a public notice, stated, "The schedule for expanding trade and investment cooperation with Kenya has been discussed since September last year, and the visit to the Netherlands is a diplomatic itinerary prepared over a significant period as a return visit to the Dutch House Speaker's visit to the National Assembly in January last year. We request Representatives Choi Soo-jin and Park Choong-kwon to retract their diplomatically discourteous remarks and issue a formal apology." (오는 29일 국회의장 임기가 종료되는 우 의장은 10일부터 약 일주일간 네덜란드·케냐 순방에 나설 예정이다. 최수진 국민의힘 원내수석대변인은 “우 의장이 ‘(의장) 졸업 여행’을 가야 해서 (일정상) 안건을 못 올린 것 아닌가”라고 했고, 박충권 원내수석대변인도 “필리버스터를 무산시켰으니 (우 의장은) 마지막 해외 출장 맘 편히 잘 다녀오라”고 했다. 조오섭 국회의장 비서실장은 언론 공지를 통해 “케냐와 작년 9월부터 무역 및 투자 협력 확대를 위한 교류 일정을 논의해 왔고, 네덜란드 방문은 작년 1월 네덜란드 하원의장의 국회 방문에 대한 답방 차원에서 상당 기간 준비한 외교 일정”이라며 “최수진·박충권 의원의 외교 결례적 발언 철회 및 공식 사과를 요청드린다”고 했다.)

Speaker Woo had also planned to submit around 50 bills with bipartisan agreement during the plenary session. Ahead of the session, the Speaker's office criticized the People Power Party's planned filibuster while mentioning the processing of 'livelihood bills.' However, after the constitutional amendment's failure, Woo concluded the plenary session without submitting any bills, delaying their processing. A People Power Party official said, "Couldn't Speaker Woo have informed the opposition of his plan to halt the amendment processing beforehand and discussed the livelihood bills? It was Speaker Woo and the Democratic Party who used the livelihood bills for political purposes." (우 의장은 이날 본회의에 여야 간 이견이 없는 법안 50여 건도 상정할 예정이었다. 국회의장 측은 이날 본회의에 앞서 ‘민생 법안’ 처리를 언급하며 국민의힘의 필리버스터 계획을 비판하기도 했다. 그러나 개헌안 처리가 무산되자 우 의장은 법안을 상정하지 않고 본회의를 끝냈고, 법안 처리는 미뤄졌다. 국민의힘 관계자는 “우 의장이 개헌 추진 중단 방침을 미리 야당에 알리고 민생 법안 처리 논의를 할 수도 있었던 것 아니냐”며 “민생 법안을 정치적으로 이용한 건 오히려 우 의장과 민주당”이라고 했다.)

item.title: No "Special Privilege" in Lee's Helicopter Transfer, Anti-Corruption Commission Reverses Its Stance (“李 헬기 이송 특혜 없었다” 말 바꾼 권익위)
item.description:
No "Special Privilege" in Lee's Helicopter Transfer, Anti-Corruption Commission Reverses Its Stance (“李 헬기 이송 특혜 없었다” 말 바꾼 권익위)

In 2024, President Lee Jae-myung (then leader of the Democratic Party of Korea), who was attacked with a knife in Busan and treated at Pusan National University Hospital, was transferred to Seoul National University Hospital via emergency helicopter. The Anti-Corruption and Civil Rights Commission (ACRC), which had previously labeled this as "special privilege," reversed its conclusion after two years. The "Task Force for Normalizing the ACRC" launched a reinvestigation and found that the use of the emergency helicopter was "the result of an official transfer agreement between hospitals" and did not violate the code of conduct for public officials. <<> ACRC Chairman Chung Il-yeon announced the results of the "Operation of the Task Force for Normalizing the ACRC" on the 8th, which included these findings. Chairman Chung, appointed by President Lee, formed this task force shortly after taking office in early March and reinvestigated decisions made by the ACRC during the Yoon Suk-yeol administration. <<> President Lee, then leader of the Democratic Party, was attacked in the neck with a knife on the morning of January 2, 2024, at the site of the new Gadeokdo Airport in Busan. He was transported to Pusan National University Hospital for treatment and later transferred to Seoul National University Hospital via emergency helicopter in the afternoon. The use of an emergency helicopter, despite the availability of treatment in Busan, sparked controversy over "special privilege." In July of that year, the ACRC concluded that it was indeed a privilege, stating that a doctor without proper authority—not the attending medical staff—had requested the helicopter dispatch, and the Busan Fire and Disaster Headquarters failed to verify whether the dispatch met regulatory requirements. It also noted violations of Seoul National University Hospital's internal regulations. <<> At the time, the ACRC demanded disciplinary action from the relevant institutions, saying that doctors from both hospitals and Busan fire officials had violated the code of conduct for public officials, which states that "no special privilege should be given to specific individuals." However, the case against President Lee's side, which allegedly requested the privilege, and Chun Joon-ho, then chief of staff for the party leader, was closed (no charges) due to the lack of a code of conduct applicable to members of the National Assembly. <<> However, the reinvestigation launched this year yielded different results. The Task Force for Normalizing the ACRC stated, "After re-interviewing hospital officials, we found that the transfer was an official decision made through consultation between hospitals, and the doctor's request for a helicopter was made within their authority." It recommended that the ACRC express regret (apologize) at the organizational level. Chairman Chung responded to the changed statements by saying, "If you ask whether the previous statements or the current ones are correct, it's difficult for us to answer," but added, "The previous conclusion was inappropriate." (2024년 부산에서 흉기 피습을 당해 부산대병원에서 치료를 받던 이재명 대통령(당시 더불어민주당 대표)이 응급 헬기를 이용해 서울대병원으로 옮겨진 것은 ‘특혜’라고 했던 국민권익위원회가 2년 만에 그 결론을 뒤집었다. ‘권익위 정상화 추진 태스크포스(TF)’가 재조사에 착수해 보니, 응급 헬기 이용은 ‘병원 간 공식적 전원(轉院) 협의 결과’로 공무원 행동강령 위반이 없었다는 것이다.)

item.title: Opposition Claims President Lee Used Anti-Corruption Commission as 'Self-Absolution' for 'Helicopter Transport Privilege' (野 “李대통령, 권익위 쥐고 ‘헬기 특혜 이송’에 셀프 면죄부”)
item.description:
Opposition Claims President Lee Used Anti-Corruption Commission as 'Self-Absolution' for 'Helicopter Transport Privilege' (野 “李대통령, 권익위 쥐고 ‘헬기 특혜 이송’에 셀프 면죄부”)

On the 9th, the People Power Party criticized the Anti-Corruption and Civil Rights Commission's announcement that there were issues in the past handling of the so-called 'emergency helicopter transport privilege controversy' involving President Lee Jae-myung during his tenure as leader of the Democratic Party of Korea. They stated, "Ahead of local elections, a state agency has volunteered as a 'memory laundry' to wipe away the president's past blemishes." <<> Senior Spokesperson Park Sung-hoon issued a commentary that day, saying, "The outcome presented by the Anti-Corruption Commission under the grandiose name of a 'Normalization Task Force (TF)' is nothing more than a 'regime-tailored past laundry.'" <<> He added, "At that time, President Lee Jae-myung bypassed Pusan National University Hospital, which is equipped with the nation's top-level regional trauma center, and called an emergency helicopter like a 'call taxi' to head to Seoul," and asked, "Is giving absolution for an act that undermined trust in local medical services and shook the foundation of the medical delivery system what the Anti-Corruption Commission calls normalization?" <<> He further argued, "The act of forcibly dragging in issues related to First Lady Kim Keon-hee and indiscriminately requesting investigations is merely a 'childish distraction' and a 'political offensive for elections,' aimed at diluting criticism over the 'helicopter privilege' controversy." <<> Previously, the Anti-Corruption Commission announced the day before that, through the activities of the Normalization TF, it had deemed inappropriate the 2004 ruling that the medical staff violated the code of conduct regarding the 'emergency helicopter transport privilege controversy,' and that the then-Secretary General had improperly intervened in this process. <<> President Lee posted a link to an article about the Anti-Corruption Commission's announcement on X (formerly Twitter) and stated, "Judicial murder through the prosecution's fabricated indictment, murder with a weapon by mobilizing terrorists, and character assassination through manipulated media. The people, that is, heaven, saved me from these grave three threats of murder." <<> In response, People Power Party lawmaker Na Kyung-won wrote on Facebook, calling it a "jaw-dropping sophistry," and said, "Under the pretext of normalizing the Anti-Corruption Commission, he twisted and shook the commission to grant himself absolution for his 'helicopter transport privilege.' Now, he's even packaging legitimate legal judgment as 'judicial murder' and pathologically obsessing over dropping charges." <<> She continued, "President Lee should stop his self-styled crime laundering and self-deification and face the suspended trials first." <<> (국민의힘은 9일 이재명 대통령의 더불어민주당 대표 때 불거진 이른바 ‘응급 헬기 이송 특혜 논란’과 관련, 과거 처리 과정에 문제가 있었다고 권익위가 발표한 것에 대해 “지방선거를 앞두고 대통령의 과거 치부를 지워주기 위해 국가기관이 스스로 ‘기억 세탁소’를 자처한 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Park Min-sik and Han Dong-hoon Hold Simultaneous Office Openings (박민식·한동훈, 한날한시 개소식)
item.description:
Park Min-sik and Han Dong-hoon Hold Simultaneous Office Openings (박민식·한동훈, 한날한시 개소식)

Park Min-sik, the People Power Party candidate, and Han Dong-hoon, an independent candidate, both running in the June 3 by-election for the Busan North Gap National Assembly seat, will hold their campaign office opening ceremonies at 2 PM on the 10th, at the same time. Their offices are located a 10-minute walk apart (about 600 meters). As both candidates have expressed their intention to "complete the race" despite calls for "conservative unification," there are predictions on the 8th that this opening ceremony will take on the aspect of a "showdown of strength." <<> At the opening ceremony for candidate Park Min-sik, party leader Jang Dong-hyuk, floor leader Song Eon-seok, and other senior lawmakers are expected to attend in large numbers. Park's camp stated that "senior lawmakers such as Kwon Young-se, Kim Ki-hyun, Na Kyung-won, and Ahn Cheol-soo, as well as several regional lawmakers from Busan, have also agreed to attend." The People Power Party's central office plans to go all out in supporting Park, even operating a press support bus—something they did not arrange when party leader Jang visited the openings of Daegu mayoral candidate Choo Kyung-ho and Busan mayoral candidate Park Hyung-jun. <<> Within the opposition, there are murmurs that "Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk will strongly check Han's independent candidacy through his congratulatory speech." Park has recently been appearing one after another on conservative YouTube channels, seeking to rally the hardcore supporter base. <<> Ahead of the opening ceremony, former lawmaker Seo Byung-soo and former lawmaker Jeong Mi-kyung have joined Han Dong-hoon's campaign. Seo, a former Busan mayor and five-term lawmaker, left the People Power Party the previous day and agreed to serve as honorary campaign committee chairman. Former lawmaker Jeong Hyung-geun, who previously served as a lawmaker for Busan North and Gangseo Gap, was brought in as the fundraising committee chairman. Regarding the controversy over Jeong’s past career at the Agency for National Security Planning (ANSP), Han stated in an MBC radio interview that day: "I do not agree with everything he has done." <<> It has been reported that Han dissuaded pro-Han lawmakers within the People Power Party from attending his opening ceremony. On MBC Radio, Han said, "To the lawmakers who expressed their intention to attend, I conveyed that I would appreciate it if they could just send their support from afar." Many pro-Han lawmakers, including Han Ji-ah and Jin Jong-oh, had originally planned to attend Han's ceremony but decided not to after Han's request. <<> Meanwhile, Ha Jung-woo, the candidate from the Democratic Party of Korea, is also holding his opening ceremony on the same day, signaling that the Busan North Gap election is set to heat up in earnest. (6·3 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거에 출마하는 박민식 국민의힘 후보와 한동훈 무소속 후보가 10일 오후 2시, 같은 시각에 선거사무소 개소식을 갖는다. 이들의 사무소는 도보로 10분 거리(약 600m)다. 두 후보 모두 ‘보수 단일화’ 요구에 대해 ‘완주’ 의지를 밝힌 만큼, 이번 개소식이 ‘세(勢) 대결’ 양상을 띨 것이란 전망이 8일 나온다.)

item.title: Indictment Cancellation Backlash Becomes Reality… Daegu and Busan, Once Led by the Ruling Party, Now a Tight Race (공소취소 역풍 현실화… 與 앞섰던 대구·부산, 박빙 됐다)
item.description:
Indictment Cancellation Backlash Becomes Reality… Daegu and Busan, Once Led by the Ruling Party, Now a Tight Race (공소취소 역풍 현실화… 與 앞섰던 대구·부산, 박빙 됐다)

In the Yeongnam region, a key battleground for the June 3 local elections, multiple opinion polls have shown the candidates from the People Power Party and the Democratic Party in a tight race. This has halted the optimism within some ruling party circles who predicted victories in 15 cities and provinces excluding North Gyeongsang Province. Polling experts noted, "As the Democratic Party pushes for a special counsel law alleging a 'fabricated indictment'—keeping open the possibility of canceling the indictment against President Lee Jae-myung—the conservative base has accelerated its consolidation." (6·3 지방선거 격전지가 된 영남권에서 국민의힘 후보와 더불어민주당 후보가 박빙 승부를 벌이고 있다는 여론조사가 잇따라 발표됐다. 경북을 제외한 15개 시·도에서 승리할 것이라던 여권 일각의 낙관론에 제동이 걸린 형국이다. 여론조사 전문가들은 “민주당이 이재명 대통령 사건 공소취소 가능성을 열어놓은 ‘조작기소’ 특검법을 추진하면서 보수층 결집이 가속화됐다”고 했다.)

In a survey commissioned by JTBC and conducted by MetaVoice and Research Lab on the 5th and 6th, targeting 804 voters in Daegu (wireless phone interview), Democratic Party candidate Kim Boo-kyum scored 40% and People Power Party candidate Choo Kyung-ho scored 41% in the Daegu mayoral race. This marks a shift from the early trend where Kim had been leading amid public attention. Choo's camp said, "The atmosphere at Daegu's Seomun Market has changed," adding, "Since this month, more people are saying, 'We need to properly stop the Democratic Party.'" (JTBC 의뢰로 메타보이스·리서치랩이 지난 5~6일 대구 유권자 804명을 대상으로 실시한 대구시장 지지도 조사(무선 전화면접)에서 민주당 김부겸 후보는 40%, 국민의힘 추경호 후보가 41%로 나타났다. 여론의 주목을 받으며 김 후보가 앞서가던 초반 흐름이 달라진 것이다. 추 후보 측은 “대구 서문시장의 공기가 달라졌다”며 “이달 들어서 ‘민주당을 제대로 막아보라’는 분들이 늘어나고 있다”고 했다.)

In a Ulsan mayoral poll commissioned by KBS Ulsan and Ulsan Maeil Newspaper and conducted by Public Opinion Polling Fair on the 4th and 5th, Democratic Party candidate Kim Sang-wook garnered 32.9% and People Power Party candidate Kim Doo-kyum received 37.1%, within the margin of error (±3.5 percentage points). Following them, Progressive Party candidate Kim Jong-hoon got 14.2% and independent Park Maeng-woo, who left the People Power Party, took 8.5%. As a result, candidate unification remains a variable in the Ulsan region. The survey was conducted via wireless automated response (ARS) and wired random digit dialing (RDD) targeting 804 voters in Ulsan. (KBS울산방송·울산매일신문 의뢰로 여론조사공정이 지난 4~5일 실시한 울산시장 지지도 조사에서 민주당 김상욱 후보 32.9%, 국민의힘 김두겸 후보 37.1%로 오차 범위(±3.5%포인트) 내였다. 뒤이어 김종훈 진보당 후보가 14.2%, 국민의힘에서 탈당한 박맹우 무소속 후보가 8.5%를 얻었다. 이 때문에 울산 지역은 후보 단일화가 여전히 변수다. 이 조사는 울산 지역 유권자 804명을 대상으로 무선 자동응답(ARS)과 유선 임의번호걸기(RDD) 방식으로 실시했다.)

The races for South Gyeongsang Province governor and Busan mayor are also neck-and-neck. In a wireless ARS survey commissioned by Gyeongnam Newspaper and conducted by Mono Research on the 1st and 2nd targeting 1,000 voters in South Gyeongsang Province, Democratic Party candidate Kim Kyoung-soo received 41.9% and People Power Party candidate Park Wan-soo got 44.1%. Another wireless ARS survey commissioned by Busan MBC and conducted by Han Gil Research on the 1st and 2nd targeting 1,013 voters in Busan showed Democratic Party Busan mayoral candidate Jeon Jae-soo at 46.9% and People Power Party candidate Park Heong-joon at 40.7%. The two candidates are within the margin of error (±3.1 percentage points). (경남지사와 부산시장 선거에서도 여야 후보가 접전을 벌이고 있다. 경남신문 의뢰로 모노리서치가 지난 1~2일 경남 유권자 1000명을 대상으로 실시한 무선 ARS 조사에서 민주당 김경수 후보가 41.9%, 국민의힘 박완수 후보가 44.1%를 얻었다. 부산MBC 의뢰로 한길리서치가 지난 1~2일 부산 지역 유권자 1013명을 상대로 실시한 무선 ARS 조사에서는 전재수 민주당 부산시장 후보가 46.9%, 박형준 국민의힘 후보는 40.7%로 나타났다. 두 후보가 오차 범위(±3.1%포인트) 안에서 다투는 형국이다.)

In the three-way Busan North Gap National Assembly by-election, Democratic Party candidate Ha Jung-woo is leading, but conservative candidates are close behind. A phone interview survey by MetaVoice commissioned by JTBC on the 4th and 5th targeting 501 voters in Busan North Gap found that 37% supported Democratic Party candidate Ha Jung-woo, 26% supported People Power Party candidate Park Min-shik, and 25% backed independent candidate Han Dong-hoon. In hypothetical head-to-head matchups, Ha Jung-woo had 44% vs. Park Min-shik's 39%, and Ha Jung-woo had 42% vs. Han Dong-hoon's 36%, both within the margin of error. (3자 구도로 치러지는 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거에선 민주당 하정우 후보가 앞서고 있지만 보수 후보들의 추격도 만만치 않다. 메타보이스가 JTBC 의뢰로 지난 4~5일 부산 북갑 지역 유권자 501명에게 전화 면접 방식으로 물은 결과 민주당 하정우 후보를 지지한다는 응답이 37%로 나타났다. 국민의힘 박민식 후보 26%, 무소속 한동훈 후보는 25%였다. 가상 양자 대결에선 하정우 후보 44% 대 박민식 후보 39%, 하정우 후보 42% 대 한동훈 후보 36%로 오차범위 내였다.)

Within the opposition, there is analysis that the shifting sentiment in the Yeongnam region is a backlash check against the Democratic Party's "rampage." A People Power Party official said, "Conservative voters who said, 'I can't stand even looking at the People Power Party' due to martial law, impeachment, and internal strife, seem to have found justification for support following the Democratic Party's push for a special counsel on indictment cancellation." While the People Power Party's party approval ratings still lag far behind the Democratic Party, there is analysis of a "decoupling" effect, where the election is candidate-focused, causing candidate support to diverge from party support. (야권에선 영남권 민심이 요동치는 배경에 대해 민주당의 ‘폭주’에 따른 견제 심리라는 분석이 나온다. 국민의힘 관계자는 “계엄과 탄핵, 당 내분으로 ‘국민의힘은 꼴도 보기 싫다’고 했던 보수 유권자들이 민주당의 공소취소 특검 추진을 계기로 지지 명분을 얻은 것 같다”고 했다. 정당 지지율에서 국민의힘은 여전히 민주당에 큰 차이로 뒤지고 있지만, 선거가 후보 중심으로 진행되면서 당 지지율과 후보 지지율이 따로 가는 ‘디커플링(탈동조화)’이 나타나고 있다는 분석도 있다.)

Initially, ahead of the June 3 local elections, the People Power Party's approval rating fell to 15%, leading to predictions within the Democratic Party of a "sweep all the way to Yeongnam." Notably, Democratic Party lawmaker Park Ji-won said in an MBC interview last month, "We'll win 15 to 1, except for North Gyeongsang Province." (당초 6·3 지방선거를 앞두고 국민의힘 정당 지지율이 15%까지 추락하면서 민주당 내부에선 “영남권까지 싹쓸이할 것”이란 전망이 제기됐다. 민주당 박지원 의원이 지난달 MBC 인터뷰에서 “15 대 1로 우리가 경북만 빼고 다 승리할 것”이라고 했던 것이 대표적이다.)

However, as the conservative base consolidates in the Yeongnam region, Democratic Party candidates in battleground areas are now issuing warnings to "maintain a low profile until the end." There are also signs of campaign camps striving to recruit moderate conservative figures. Amid this, the Democratic Party leadership is re-emphasizing the "insurrection judgment" narrative. Democratic Party leader Jeong Cheong-rae, teary-eyed during a party meeting today, said, "If the martial law had succeeded, President Lee Jae-myung and I might have ended up as crab feed." (그러나 영남권에서 보수층이 결집하는 흐름이 만들어지자 접전지 민주당 후보들을 중심으로 “끝까지 낮은 자세로 선거에 임해야 한다”는 경고음이 나온다. 후보 캠프에선 중도 보수 성향의 인사를 영입하는 데 공을 들이는 기류도 감지된다. 이런 가운데 민주당 지도부는 ‘내란 심판론’을 다시 강조하고 있다. 정청래 민주당 대표는 이날 당 회의에서 “만약 계엄이 성공했더라면 이재명 대통령도, 저도 혹시 꽃게밥이 되지 않았겠느냐”며 울먹였다.)

item.title: President Lee: "The People Saved Me, So My Life is Entirely Theirs" (李 대통령 “국민이 살려주셨으니 제 목숨은 온전히 국민의 것”)
item.description:
President Lee: "The People Saved Me, So My Life is Entirely Theirs" (李 대통령 “국민이 살려주셨으니 제 목숨은 온전히 국민의 것”)

President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 9th, "The people, who are like heaven, saved me, so my life now belongs entirely to them." (이재명 대통령은 9일 “국민 곧 하늘이 저를 살려 주셨으니 제 목숨은 이제 온전히 국민의 것”이라고 했다.)

On that day, Lee shared on X (formerly Twitter) an article about a decision by the Anti-Corruption and Civil Rights Commission which, after two years, reversed its stance and ruled that no special favors were involved in the incident where he was attacked with a knife in Busan in January 2024 while serving as party leader, and was subsequently transported to Seoul National University Hospital via emergency helicopter—a case that had sparked controversy over alleged preferential treatment. (이 대통령은 이날 X(옛 트위터)에 2024년 1월 당 대표 당시 부산에서 흉기 피습을 당해 응급 헬기로 서울대병원으로 옮겨져 ‘특혜’ 논란이 일었던 사건을 국민권익위원회가 특혜가 없었다고 2년 만에 바꾼 결정에 대한 기사를 공유하며 이같이 밝혔다.)

The Commission's decision prompted him to once again recall the moment of danger he faced at that time. President Lee mentioned "judicial murder through fabricated prosecutions, attempted murder with a weapon by a terrorist, and character assassination through manipulated media," adding, "Since the people, who are like heaven, saved me from these grave threats of three-fold murder, my life is now entirely theirs." (권익위 결정을 계기로 재차 당시 위험에 처했던 순간을 소환한 것이다. 이 대통령은 “검찰의 조작 기소를 통한 사법 살인, 테러범을 동원한 흉기 살인, 조작 언론을 동원한 명예 살인”을 언급하며 “이 위중한 3대 살인 위협으로부터 국민 곧 하늘이 저를 살려 주셨으니 제 목숨은 이제 온전히 국민의 것”이라고 했다.)

President Lee continued, "Heaven has entrusted me with not only preserving my life but also with great responsibilities, so my only task is to create a nation for the people and a power that operates solely for the people." He expressed gratitude, saying, "My fellow citizens, I am simply grateful." He further stated, "Even if my body breaks down to the very last moment, I will devote all my heart and strength to the people, who are like heaven." (이 대통령은 “하늘이 제게 생명 보전을 넘어 큰 일까지 맡겨 주셨으니 제가 할 일은 오로지 국민을 위한 나라, 오로지 국민만을 위해 작동하는 권력을 만드는 것”이라며 “국민 여러분, 그저 고맙습니다”라고 했다. 이어 “마지막 한 순간까지 몸이 부서지는 한이 있더라도, 국민 곧 하늘을 위해 충심과 전력을 다하겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: Chung Cheong-rae: "Sejong City, Where Roh Moo-hyun Planted the Flag and Lee Hae-chan Cultivated... We Will Complete the Special Act on the Administrative Capital" (정청래 “노무현 깃발 꽂고 이해찬이 가꾼 세종시...행정수도특별법 완성할 것”)
item.description:
Chung Cheong-rae: "Sejong City, Where Roh Moo-hyun Planted the Flag and Lee Hae-chan Cultivated... We Will Complete the Special Act on the Administrative Capital" (정청래 “노무현 깃발 꽂고 이해찬이 가꾼 세종시...행정수도특별법 완성할 것”)

On the 9th, Chung Cheong-rae, leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, stated, "Once the June 3 local elections are over, we will make every effort within the party to pass the Special Act on the Administrative Capital, ensuring that Sejong City—where former President Roh Moo-hyun planted the flag and former Prime Minister Lee Hae-chan nurtured with his hands—can function as a true administrative capital, with various benefits concentrated here." (정청래 더불어민주당 대표는 9일 “6·3 지방선거가 끝나면 본격적으로 행정수도특별법을 통과시켜 명실공히 노무현 (전) 대통령이 깃발을 꽂고 이해찬(전 총리)의 손으로 가꿔온 세종시가 행정수도로서 기능할 수 있도록, 각종 특혜가 이곳에 이뤄질 수 있도록 당에서 전심전력으로 행정수도특별법을 통과시키는 데 최선을 다하겠다”고 했다.)

Leader Chung attended the inaugural ceremony of Cho Sang-ho’s election campaign committee for Sejong Special City mayor that morning and said, "Former President Roh Moo-hyun promised to pass the Special Act on the Administrative Capital, but his plan to relocate the administrative capital was thwarted by the absurd reason of 'customary constitution.'" (정 대표는 이날 오전 조상호 세종특별시장 후보 선거대책위원회 발족식에 참석해 “‘행정수도특별법 반드시 통과시키겠다’ 노무현 (전) 대통령께서 공약하셨던 행정수도 이전이 관습 헌법이라는 말도 되지 않는 이유로 무산됐다”며 이같이 말했다.)

He continued, "While the name, location, and site of a complete capital will be determined through constitutional amendment, once the Special Act on the Administrative Capital is passed, Sejong City can fully establish its status as a specialized capital, and various corresponding benefits will follow. I also believe that matters such as the presidential office will progress step by step after the law is enacted." (이어 “완벽한 수도에 대한 명칭과 장소, 위치는 헌법 개정을 통해 이뤄지겠지만 행정수도특별법이 통과되면 특화 수도로서 세종시가 그 위상을 충분하게 가질 수 있고, 거기에 따른 여러 가지 특혜는 따라오리라 생각한다”며 “그리고 대통령 집무실 같은 경우도 앞으로 그 법이 통과되면 차차 진행될 것으로 믿고 있다”고 했다.)

He added, "If candidate Cho Sang-ho becomes Sejong City mayor, I will do my utmost so that people can physically and visually feel that 'the Lee Jae-myung administration and the Democratic Party are clearly supporting him.' In that case, Sejong City will become truly special—small in population but serving as a central hub that gathers and elevates Korea's energy." (그는 “조상호 후보가 세종시장이 되면 ‘확실하게 이재명 정부와 민주당이 확실하게 지원하고 있구나’ 하는 것을 몸으로, 눈으로 느낄 수 있도록 최선을 다하겠다”며 “이렇게 되면 세종시가 대한민국의 중심 도시로서 인구는 작지만 대한민국의 기운을 더 모아 상승시키는 진짜 특별한 도시가 될 것”이라고 말했다.)

Regarding candidate Cho, he remarked, "He knows the path that Lee Hae-chan walked better than anyone, and he has internalized the tasks Lee Hae-chan pursued and the spirit he embodied more than anyone. He is Lee Hae-chan’s shadow and his political son." (조 후보를 향해선 “이해찬이 걸어온 길을 누구보다 잘 알고 있고 또 이해찬이 하고자 했던 일, 또 이해찬이 갖고 있던 정신을 누구보다 몸으로 체화한 사람”이라며 “이해찬의 그림자고 이해찬의 정치적 아들”이라고 언급했다.)

Kang Jun-hyun, senior spokesperson for the Democratic Party, also said, "As soon as the local elections are over, we will fulfill our role in the National Assembly’s Land, Infrastructure, and Transport Committee to ensure this bill (the Special Act on the Administrative Capital) is passed. Together with candidate Cho, we will deliver a truly great gift to Sejong City." (강준현 민주당 수석대변인도 “지방선거 끝나자마자 (국회) 국토교통위원회에서 이(행정수도특별법) 법안을 반드시 통과시킬 수 있도록 국회에서 역할을 다하겠다”며 “조 후보와 합심해서 정말 큰 선물을 세종시에 안겨드리도록 하겠다”고 했다.)

Candidate Cho responded, "Since the leader has promised to take responsibility for the administrative capital, I will take responsibility for Sejong City’s self-sufficiency and quality of life. I believe that a nation where Seoul and the regions prosper evenly relies on the completion of the administrative capital." <<>> (조 후보는 “대표께서 행정수도는 책임져주신다고 하셨으니까 세종시 자족 기능과 삶의 질 문제는 제가 책임지겠다”며 “서울과 지방이 고르게 잘사는 나라가 되는 것은 행정수도의 완성에 달려 있다고 생각한다”고 말했다．)

item.title: “I’m a Pragmatic Pro-Lee… Kim Young-hwan Ended with the Osong Disaster” (“난 실용적 친명… 김영환, 오송 참사 때 끝나”)
item.description:
“I’m a Pragmatic Pro-Lee… Kim Young-hwan Ended with the Osong Disaster” (“난 실용적 친명… 김영환, 오송 참사 때 끝나”)

Shin Yong-han, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate for Chungcheongbuk-do governor, said on the 7th, “Chungbuk stands at a crossroads between regressing to the past and advancing to the future,” adding, “I will open an era of Chungbuk-led growth.” Candidate Shin joined the Democratic Party in 2024 after being in the conservative camp and served as the vice-chairman of the Presidential Committee for Regional Development after the presidential election. Describing himself as ‘pro-Lee,’ he stated, “The part I most want to emulate from President Lee Jae-myung is his pragmatic code,” and he vowed, “I will create a completely new Chungbuk through policies focused on people’s livelihoods and pragmatism, not on factions or ideology.” (더불어민주당 신용한 충북지사 후보는 지난 7일 “충북은 과거로 퇴행할지, 미래로 전진할지 갈림길에 서 있다”며 “충북 주도 성장 시대를 열겠다”고 했다. 신 후보는 보수 진영에 있다가 2024년 민주당에 합류했고, 대선 후 대통령 직속 지방시대위원회 부위원장을 지냈다. 자신을 ‘친명’이라고 평가한 그는 “이재명 대통령과 가장 닮고자 하는 부분은 실용 코드”라며 “정파나 이념이 아니라 민생과 실용주의 정책으로 완전히 새로운 충북을 만들겠다”고 했다.)

Regarding the People Power Party’s incumbent candidate Kim Young-hwan, who is running for re-election, Candidate Shin said, “What matters is not the number of signed MOUs for investment attraction but actual results; there has been a lack of tangible change for residents across the provincial administration.” He also mentioned the response to the 2023 Cheongju Osong disaster in Chungbuk, saying, “Wouldn’t you say the assessment that (Candidate Kim) lacked the leadership and communication skills of a public servant is already settled?” (신 후보는 재선에 나선 국민의힘 김영환 후보에 대해 “투자 유치 MOU(양해 각서) 숫자보다 실제 결과가 중요하고, 도정 전반에서 도민 체감 변화가 부족했다”고 했다. 또 2023년 충북 청주 오송 참사 대응을 언급하며 “(김 후보가) 섬기는 리더십과 소통 능력이 부족했다는 평가가 이미 끝난 것 아니겠나”라고 했다.)

-You joined the Democratic Party after being in a conservative party. (-보수 정당에 있다가 민주당으로 합류했다.)

“When President Lee Jae-myung was the leader of the Democratic Party, he personally recruited me, saying I was a ‘talent who would broaden the Democratic Party’s scope.’ He recruited me from a pragmatic perspective, seeing my background as the youth committee chair under the Park Geun-hye administration and my experience as an economic news anchor. Indeed, President Lee also governs with a pragmatic focus, not getting bogged down by ideological lines. For me too, the part I most want to emulate is that pragmatic code. Some attack me by calling me ‘Myung-pick,’ but to me, it’s like an honorable badge.” (“이재명 대통령이 민주당 당대표 시절 저를 영입하면서 ‘민주당의 외연을 넓혀줄 인재’라고 직접 말했다. 박근혜 정부에서 청년위원장을 했던 이력, 경제방송 앵커 경력 등을 보고 실용적 관점에서 영입한 것이다. 실제 이 대통령도 이념 노선에 매몰되지 않고 실용 중심 국정을 하지 않나. 저 역시 가장 닮고자 하는 부분이 그 실용 코드다. 일부에서 ‘명픽’이라고 공격하지만, 저에겐 영광스러운 훈장 같은 말이다.”)

-How would you evaluate the four years of Governor Kim Young-hwan’s administration? (-김영환 후보 도정 4년을 평가한다면.)

“He often emphasizes economic achievements, talking about 80 trillion won or 100 trillion won in investment attraction. But the key is not the numbers in MOUs but whether they led to actual investment. The lack of communication and controversy over leadership revealed during the response to the Osong disaster were major disappointments for residents. The starting point of modern administration is communication, and yet an image of uncommunicativeness has already been strongly imprinted. Of course, I’m not saying there were no achievements at all. Areas like raising the birth rate had significance.” (“경제 성과를 강조하며 투자 유치 80조원, 100조원 이야기를 많이 한다. 그런데 중요한 것은 MOU상의 숫자가 아니라 실제 투자로 이어졌는지 여부다. 오송 참사 대응 과정에서 드러난 소통 부재와 리더십 논란은 도민들이 크게 실망한 부분이다. 현대 행정의 출발점은 소통인데 이미 불통 이미지가 강하게 각인돼 있다. 물론 성과가 전혀 없었다는 건 아니다. 출산율 제고 같은 부분은 의미가 있었다.”)

-What is the most urgent task in Chungbuk? (-충북에서 가장 시급한 과제는 무엇인가.)

“The disparity between Cheongju and Chungju, population decline, and the outflow of young people all ultimately connect to the lack of quality jobs and settlement conditions. Chungbuk has a strong manufacturing base in semiconductors, secondary batteries, and biotechnology, but the startup ecosystem to nurture these into future growth companies is weak. We need to transform the manufacturing-centered economy into an AI and digital-based innovative startup economy. I will also address the ‘ER crisis’ as soon as possible. The recent incident in Chungbuk where a fetus died was a symbolic event showing the collapse of essential medical care in the province. The death rate for emergency patients is much higher than in the capital area, and the outflow of critically ill patients is severe. I will introduce an AI-based real-time emergency medical control system to automatically match beds and specialists, and secure essential medical personnel through a regional doctor system tailored to Chungbuk.” (“청주·충주 격차, 인구 감소, 청년 유출 문제 모두 결국 좋은 일자리와 정주 여건 부족으로 연결된다. 충북은 반도체·이차전지·바이오 같은 강한 제조 기반은 갖췄지만, 이를 미래 성장 기업으로 키워낼 창업 생태계는 약하다. 제조업 중심 경제를 AI·디지털 기반 혁신 창업 경제로 전환해야 한다. ‘응급실 뺑뺑이’ 문제도 하루빨리 손보겠다. 최근 충북에서 태아가 사망한 사건은 충북 필수 의료 체계 붕괴를 보여준 상징적 사건이었다. 응급환자 사망률이 수도권보다 훨씬 높고 중증 환자 유출도 심각하다. AI 기반 실시간 응급의료 관제 시스템을 도입해 병상과 전문의를 자동 매칭하고, 충북형 지역의사제를 통해 필수 의료 인력을 확보하겠다.”)

-‘Chungbuk, a Special Startup Province’ is a pledge. (-‘창업특별도 충북’이 공약이다.)

“I will create a 2000 billion won startup fund for Chungbuk and focus on fostering tech startups linked to semiconductors, secondary batteries, and biotechnology. I also plan to establish a ‘second chance’ system so people can try again even after failure. I will actively push for the relocation of secondary public institutions. I aim to attract public institutions in aviation, energy, environment, finance, and biotechnology fields linked to Chungbuk’s industries. Public institutions are not just about relocating buildings; they are anchor institutions that bring jobs, consumption, and research functions together.” (“충북 창업펀드 2000억원을 조성하고 반도체·이차전지·바이오와 연계한 기술 창업을 집중 육성하겠다. 실패해도 다시 도전할 수 있는 ‘패자부활전’ 시스템도 만들 생각이다. 2차 공공기관 이전도 적극 추진하겠다. 항공·에너지·환경·금융·바이오 분야 공공기관을 충북 산업과 연계해 유치할 생각이다. 공공기관은 단순한 건물 이전이 아니라 일자리와 소비, 연구 기능까지 함께 가져오는 앵커 기관이다.”)

-Your stance on the Daejeon, Sejong, South Chungcheong, and North Chungcheong megacity plan? (-대전·세종·충남·충북 메가시티 구상에 대한 입장은.)

“I agree with the big picture. The Chungcheong region wide-area union is already operating, and discussions on integrating economic and living zones are underway. There’s no reason to back out over fears that Chungbuk might be marginalized. Chungbuk’s industrial structure centered on semiconductors, biotechnology, and secondary batteries is highly competitive. Its per capita GRDP is also in the top ranks nationally. In the trend of regionalization, I believe Chungbuk can actually play a central role.” (“큰 틀에서는 동의한다. 이미 충청권 광역연합이 운영되고 있고 경제권·생활권 통합 논의도 진행 중이다. 충북이 소외될 거라는 우려 때문에 발을 뺄 이유는 없다. 충북의 산업 구조는 반도체·바이오·이차전지 중심으로 굉장히 경쟁력이 있다. 1인당 GRDP도 전국 상위권이다. 광역화 흐름 속에서 충북이 오히려 중심 역할을 할 수 있다고 본다.”)

-Some Democratic Party candidates have expressed concerns about the party’s ‘fabricated indictment’ special counsel law. (-일부 민주당 후보들은 민주당의 ‘조작 기소’ 특검법에 대해 우려를 표했다.)

“In the field, it doesn’t feel like national political issues become direct core issues during local elections. However, if the People Power Party strategically uses it to launch attacks, it could have some impact. Since Chungbuk is a relatively conservative-leaning region, if provocative political issues flare up just before the election, it could be a burden for candidates.” (“현장에서 느끼기에는 지방선거 국면에서 국회 정치 현안이 직접적인 핵심 이슈가 되지는 않는다. 다만 국민의힘이 이를 정략적으로 활용해 공세를 펼칠 경우 일부 영향을 줄 수는 있다. 충북은 상대적으로 보수 성향이 강한 지역인 만큼 자극적인 정치 이슈가 선거 직전에 불거지면 후보 입장에서는 부담이 될 수도 있다.”)

-What public sentiment do you feel in the field? (-현장에서 느끼는 민심 어떤가.)

“Many of the residents who previously elected a People Power Party candidate as governor are now saying, ‘It’s time for a change.’ I’m not talking about generational shift just because of age. There’s a great fatigue with the oldness of Chungbuk politics. It’s a matter of whether to stay in the past or move toward the future. Especially on issues of future growth engines and jobs, I feel many residents are placing their hopes on me.” (“지난번 국민의힘 후보를 도지사로 만들었던 도민들도 ‘이제는 바꿔야 한다’는 이야기를 굉장히 많이 한다. 단순히 나이 때문에 세대교체를 말하는 게 아니다. 충북 정치의 낡음에 대한 피로감이 크다. 과거에 머물 것이냐, 미래로 갈 것이냐의 문제다. 특히 미래 먹거리와 일자리 문제에서는 저에게 기대를 거는 도민들이 많다고 느낀다.”)

-Candidate Kim Young-hwan said, “We mustn’t shake up the Jang Dong-hyuk leadership.” (-김영환 후보는 “장동혁 지도부를 흔들지 말아야 한다”고 했다.)

“I resigned from the Yoon Suk Yeol government’s transition committee and left. Watching from close up, I felt it was a very dangerous leadership. Even after the December 3 martial law and impeachment, the People Power Party has shown no true reflection or repentance. Candidate Kim Young-hwan, far from breaking ties with former President Yoon Suk Yeol, has practically acted like his bodyguard. At the very least, he should apologize to the public and show he is drawing a line with former President Yoon.” (“저는 윤석열 정부 인수위 시절 사표를 내고 나온 사람이다. 가까이서 지켜보며 굉장히 위험한 리더십이라고 느꼈다. 국민의힘은 12·3 비상계엄과 탄핵까지 벌어졌는데도 진정한 반성과 참회가 없다. 김영환 후보 역시 윤석열 전 대통령과 절연하기는커녕 사실상 호위무사처럼 행동해왔다. 최소한 국민께 사과하고 윤 전 대통령과 선을 긋는 모습은 보여야 한다.”)

☞Who is Shin Yong-han (☞신용한은 누구)

Born in Cheongju, Chungbuk, he graduated from Cheongju High School and Yonsei University with degrees in Business Administration and Law. He served as the chair of the Youth Committee under the Park Geun-hye administration. In 2021, during the People Power Party’s primary for the presidential election, he was the operations director for Won Hee-ryong’s camp, and after Yoon Suk Yeol was confirmed as the candidate, he oversaw policy implementation in the camp. In 2024, he joined the Democratic Party as the 15th recruited talent by then-leader Lee Jae-myung. (충북 청주 출신으로 청주고와 연세대 경영학과·법학과를 졸업했다. 박근혜 정부에서 청년위원회 위원장을 지냈다. 2021년 국민의힘 대선 경선 당시 원희룡 캠프 상황실장을 맡았고, 윤석열 후보로 확정된 후 캠프에서 정책 실무를 총괄했다. 2024년 이재명 당시 더불어민주당 대표의 15호 영입 인재로 민주당에 합류했다.)

item.title: Ahn Gyu-baek to Visit U.S. Tomorrow... Discussions on Wartime Operational Control and U.S. Forces Korea (안규백, 내일 미국 간다... 전작권, 주한미군 등 논의)
item.description:
Amid tensions between South Korea and the U.S. over issues such as the transfer of wartime operational control (OPCON) and intelligence sharing on North Korea, Defense Minister Ahn Gyu-baek is making a surprise visit to the United States. (한미가 전시작전통제권(전작권) 전환, 대북 정보 공유 등 여러 현안과 관련해 갈등을 빚는 가운데 안규백 국방부 장관이 전격적으로 미국을 찾는다.)

The Ministry of National Defense announced on the 9th that Minister Ahn will visit the U.S. from the 10th to the 14th. This marks Ahn's first trip to the U.S. since taking office in July of last year. (국방부는 안 장관이 오는 10∼14일 미국을 방문한다고 9일 밝혔다. 지난해 7월 취임한 안 장관의 첫 방미다.)

Minister Ahn is scheduled to hold talks with U.S. Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth in Washington D.C. on the 11th (local time), and will meet with U.S. government and congressional officials, including the Acting Secretary of the Navy, the Chair and Ranking Member of the Senate Armed Services Committee, and the Chair of the Seapower Subcommittee. (안 장관은 11일(현지시각) 워싱턴D.C에서 피트 헤그세스 미국 국방부(전쟁부) 장관과 회담을 하고, 미국 해군성장관 대행, 상원 군사위원장 및 간사, 해양력소위원장 등 미측 정부와 의회 인사를 만날 예정이다.)

A defense ministry official stated regarding the visit, "It is aimed at direct high-level communication to follow up on the implementation of agreements from the South Korea-U.S. summit and the Security Consultative Meeting (SCM)," adding, "Key issues such as OPCON transfer and nuclear-powered submarines will be discussed." (국방부 관계자는 이번 방미에 대해 “한미정상회담, SCM 합의사항 후속조치 관련 이행 점검차 고위급 간 직접 소통하려는 것”이라며 “전작권, 핵추진잠수함 등이 주요 현안으로 논의될 것”이라고 말했다.)

The visit comes at a time when sensitive issues between Seoul and Washington have accumulated, including OPCON transfer, cooperation in building nuclear-powered submarines, contributions to freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz, and U.S. restrictions on sharing satellite intelligence on North Korea. (이번 방미는 전작권은 물론 핵추진잠수함 건조 협력, 호르무즈 해협 항행자유 기여 문제, 미국의 대북위성정보 공유 제한 등 한미간 민감한 현안이 누적된 가운데 이뤄지는 것이다.)

The Lee Jae-myung administration, which has set OPCON transfer within its term as a national task, is considering 2028—before the current U.S. administration's term ends—as a target year for the transfer. (임기 내 전작권 전환을 국정과제로 추진하는 이재명 정부는 한미 현 행정부 임기가 끝나기 전인 2028년을 전작권 전환 목표연도로 검토하고 있다.)

At last year's SCM, the two defense ministers agreed to establish a roadmap for meeting OPCON transfer conditions and to complete the second of three verification phases this year. (양국 국방장관이 지난해 개최한 한미안보협의회(SCM)에서는 전작권 전환 조건 충족에 관한 로드맵을 마련하고 3단계 조건 달성 여부 검증 절차 중 2단계를 올해 중 완료하기로 합의하기도 했다.)

However, recent testimony by U.S. Forces Korea Commander General Xavier Brunson in a congressional hearing, where he mentioned the first quarter of 2029 as a target, revealed a gap in perceptions. (그러나 최근 제이비어 브런슨 주한미군사령관이 의회 청문회에서 2029년 1분기를 목표 시점으로 언급하며 인식차가 드러났다.)

Cooperation on building nuclear-powered submarines, as agreed in the joint fact sheet issued by the South Korean and U.S. presidents last year, has been slow to advance in follow-up consultations amid the negative fallout from the "Coupang issue." (한미 정상이 지난해 조인트 팩트시트(공동 설명자료)에서 합의한 핵추진잠수함 건조 협력 등은 쿠팡 문제의 부정적 여파 속에서 좀처럼 후속 협의에 속도를 내지 못하는 상황이다.)

The government faces growing concerns as the U.S. recently urged South Korea to contribute to efforts to resume navigation through the Strait of Hormuz. President Trump also inflated the size of U.S. Forces Korea to 45,000 troops while expressing dissatisfaction with South Korea. (최근 미국이 호르무즈 해협 통항 재개를 위한 노력에 한국의 기여를 촉구하면서 정부로서는 고민이 늘어난 상황이 됐다. 트럼프 대통령은 한국에 불만을 표출하는 과정에서 주한미군 규모를 ‘4만5000명’이라고 부풀려 말하기도 했다.)

Attention is focused on whether this direct meeting between the top defense officials of South Korea and the U.S. can create a turning point in addressing the overall alliance agenda. (이런 가운데 진행되는 한미 국방 수장의 직접 대좌를 통해 동맹 현안 전반에 국면 전환의 단초를 만들 수 있을지 주목된다.)

During his U.S. visit, Minister Ahn is also expected to meet with the Acting Secretary of the Navy, where the issue of nuclear submarines is likely to be discussed. (안 장관은 방미 중 미국 해군성 장관 대행도 만날 예정으로, 해당 면담에서도 핵잠 문제가 논의될 것으로 보인다.)

Coinciding with Minister Ahn's visit, South Korea and the U.S. will hold the Korea-U.S. Integrated Defense Dialogue (KIDD), a deputy minister-level defense consultative body, in Washington D.C. on the 12th and 13th. (한미는 안 장관 방미 기간과 맞물리는 12∼13일 미국 워싱턴DC에서 국방당국 차관보급 회의체인 ‘통합국방협의체’(KIDD) 회의도 개최한다.)

The KIDD meeting will also address overall alliance security issues, including OPCON transfer. Some speculate that Minister Ahn's separate visit to the U.S. may reflect an awareness of the need to create a inflection point through high-level consultations. (KIDD 회의에서도 전작권 등 동맹 안보현안 전반이 논의되는데 안 장관이 별도로 방미하는 것은 고위급 협의를 통한 변곡점 마련 필요성을 의식한 것 아니냐는 관측도 제기된다.)

Amid a series of recent flashpoints in South Korea-U.S. relations, visits by key South Korean officials to the U.S. have been ongoing. Late last month, Jeong Yeon-doo, Director of the Foreign Ministry's Foreign Policy and Intelligence Division, and Cho Hyun-woo, Senior Presidential Secretary for Security Strategy, visited Washington D.C. (최근 한미 현안이 잇달아 불거진 가운데 한국 핵심 당국자들의 방미가 이어지는 양상이다. 지난달 하순에는 한국 정부의 대북 외교 수석대표인 정연두 외교부 외교전략정보본부장과 조현우 청와대 안보전략비서관이 워싱턴D.C를 찾았다.)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk: "When I Asked My Elderly Mother What 'Indictment Withdrawal' Means, She Got Angry, Saying 'Are You Disrespecting Me?'" (장동혁 “노모에 ‘공소 취소’ 뜻 물어보니 ‘나 무시하냐’며 역정”)
item.description:
On the 9th, People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk, regarding the so-called 'Special Bill on Manipulated Indictments,' shared an anecdote about asking his elderly mother what 'indictment withdrawal' meant and getting scolded, indirectly criticizing Democratic Party lawmaker Park Seong-jun, who said that 'a significant number of citizens don't know what indictment withdrawal means.' (국민의힘 장동혁 대표는 9일 이른바 ‘조작기소 특검법안’과 관련, 자신의 노모에게 공소취소의 뜻이 무엇인지 물었다가 혼났다는 일화를 전하면서 ‘국민 상당수는 공소취소를 모른다’는 취지로 발언한 더불어민주당 박성준 의원을 우회적으로 비판했다.)

Jang, a former judge, wrote on Facebook that day, "I saw my 95-year-old mother for the first time in a while. She was muttering that Lee Jae-myung lied about selling his house and now he's making a fuss about withdrawing the indictment, so I asked her if she knew what indictment withdrawal means." (판사 출신인 장 대표는 이날 페이스북에 “오랜만에 95세 노모를 뵈었다. (어머니께서) 이재명이 집 팔았다고 거짓말하더니 이제 공소 취소한다고 지랄이라고 구시렁거리시길래 공소 취소가 무언지 아시냐 물었다”고 썼다.)

He continued, saying his mother got upset and said, "Are you disrespecting me?" Adding, "Oh well, it wasn't disrespect—I was just asking because the Democratic Party's Park Seong-jun said nine out of ten people don't even know what indictment withdrawal means..." (이어 자신의 어머니가 “너 나 무시허냐”며 역정을 냈다면서 “참나, 무시하는 것이 아니라 민주당 박성준이 국민 열에 아홉은 공소취소가 뭔지도 모른다고 해서 물어본 건데…”라고 했다.)

Earlier, on the 6th, Park appeared on a radio program and mentioned, "Ask citizens 'What is indictment withdrawal?' Eight to nine out of ten people don't know the meaning well." (앞서 박 의원은 지난 6일 라디오 방송에 출연해 “시민들에게 ‘공소취소가 뭐예요?’라고 물어보라. 10명 중 8~9명은 뜻을 잘 모른다”고 언급한 바 있다.)

Meanwhile, regarding the Korean cargo ship HMM Namu, which recently caught fire while anchored in the Strait of Hormuz—blocked due to the US-Iran war—Jang wrote, "The government seems to be preparing to conclude it's not an attack, even though it should be thoroughly preparing for an attack scenario. What are they so afraid of?" (한편 장 대표는 미국과 이란의 전쟁으로 봉쇄된 호르무즈 해협에서 정박하다 최근 화재가 발생한 한국 화물선 HMM 나무호와 관련, “(정부가) ‘피격’을 염두에 두고 철저하게 대비해도 모자랄 판에, 아니라고 결론 내릴 준비부터 하는 것 같다”며 “뭐가 그리 무서운 걸까”라고 적었다.)

He then addressed the government's humanitarian aid to Iran, saying, "We gave $500,000 to Iran, which is at war with our ally the US. We don't even have dialogue with the US, but we sent a special envoy to Iran. Everyone knows Iran is North Korea's friend. Is there something they're hiding?" (이어 정부의 대이란 인도 지원을 거론하며 “동맹국 미국과 전쟁 중인 이란에 돈 50만 달러를 갖다 바쳤다. 미국과는 대화도 안 하면서 이란에는 특사까지 보냈다”며 “이란이 북한 친구인 건 세상이 다 아는 사실이다. 뭐 꼬투리 잡힌 일이라도 있는 걸까”라고 말했다.)

He also posted a screenshot of Lee Jae-myung's SNS post from 2014 when he was mayor of Seongnam, which read, "Research paper says Cheonan collided with a submarine," and claimed, "At this rate, they might say the Namu also collided with a submarine." (그러면서 이재명 대통령이 2014년 성남시장 시절 SNS에 ‘’천안함은 잠수함과 충돌' 연구논문 나와’라고 쓴 글을 캡처해 올린 뒤 “이러다가 나무호도 잠수함과 충돌했다고 할지 모르겠다”라고 주장했다.)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk: "Kim Eo-jun Confirms His Role as Ruling Party's Kingmaker… If Jung Won-oh Becomes Mayor, TBS Will Become the 'Teol Bo System'" (장동혁 “김어준, 與 상왕 인증…정원오 시장되면 TBS가 ‘털보시스템’으로”)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk: "Kim Eo-jun Confirms His Role as Ruling Party's Kingmaker… If Jung Won-oh Becomes Mayor, TBS Will Become the 'Teol Bo System'" (장동혁 “김어준, 與 상왕 인증…정원오 시장되면 TBS가 ‘털보시스템’으로”)

Jang Dong-hyuk, leader of the People Power Party, stated on the 9th regarding the extensive appearances of Democratic Party of Korea candidates for metropolitan mayoral and gubernatorial positions on broadcaster Kim Eo-jun's show, "Kim Eo-jun has confirmed that he is the true kingmaker of the Democratic Party." (장동혁 국민의힘 대표는 9일 방송인 김어준씨 방송에 더불어민주당 광역단체장 후보들이 대거 출연한 것을 두고 “김어준이 진짜 민주당 상왕임을 인증했다”고 했다.)

Representative Jang posted on Facebook that day, saying, "Among the 16 metropolitan candidates, including Jung Won-oh, Choo Mi-ae, Jeon Jae-soo, Kim Sang-wook, Kim Kyung-soo, and Woo Sang-ho, 14 of them bowed their heads before Kim Eo-jun," and made this statement. (장 대표는 이날 페이스북을 통해 “정원오, 추미애, 전재수, 김상욱, 김경수, 우상호 등 16명 광역단체장 후보들 중에 14명이 김어준 앞에 머리를 조아렸다”며 이같이 밝혔다.)

Jang asserted, "Lee Jae-myung has all but ruined his chances of avoiding prison, and Jeong Cheong-rae, while trying to play the 'oppa' role, is losing votes, so they have no choice but to prostrate themselves before Kim Eo-jun, who even raises funds for them." (장 대표는 “이재명은 감방 안 가려다 산통 다 깨고, 정청래는 ‘오빠’ 되려다가 표 날리는 판이니 후원금까지 모아주는 김어준에게 납작 엎드릴 수밖에 없다”고 주장했다.)

He further remarked, "Kim Eo-jun, whom even Lee Jae-myung can't touch, now holds the reins of the Democratic Party candidates. If they become mayors or governors, public officials might have to wait outside Kim's door with approval documents in hand." (이어 “이재명도 못 건드리는 김어준이 민주당 후보들 목줄까지 쥐었으니 이들이 시장되고 도지사되면 공무원들이 결재판 들고 김어준 방 앞에 대기해야 할지도 모르겠다”고 말했다.)

Specifically targeting Jung Won-oh, the Democratic Party candidate for Seoul mayor, Jang argued, "If Jung Won-oh somehow becomes mayor, TBS [a local broadcaster] will be rebranded as the 'Teol Bo System' [a play on 'bearded man system,' referencing Kim's nickname 'Teol Bo']. This is a reference to Kim's nickname 'Teol Bo' (hairy man)." (장 대표는 특히 정원오 더불어민주당 서울시장 후보를 겨냥해 “혹시라도 정원오가 시장되면 TBS는 ‘Teol Bo System’(털보 시스템)으로 바뀌겠다”고 주장했다. 김씨의 별칭인 ‘털보’를 언급한 표현이다.)

He added, "Lee Jae-myung is ruining the country, Kim Eo-jun is ruining Lee Jae-myung, and they're ruining the local governments too," concluding, "South Korea has truly become a country that makes you scratch your head." (그러면서 “이재명은 나라 말아먹고, 김어준은 이재명 말아먹고, 지방까지 말아먹고 있다”며 “대한민국이 진짜로 골 때리는 나라가 됐다”고 했다.)

item.title: "Jang Dong-hyuk, not satisfied with the 'Yoon Again' regression, tramples on the wounded hearts of the people" (與 “장동혁, 윤어게인 회귀도 모자라 상처입은 국민마음 짓밟아” )
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea criticized on the 9th, "The People Power Party is not only reverting to 'Yoon Again,' but has also trampled on the hearts of the people wounded by the insurrection." <<> Senior Spokesperson Kang Jun-hyun stated in a written briefing, referring to remarks by People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk during a foreign press conference where he said "Impeachment is not the only way to resolve the martial law," calling it "rash nonsense." <<> Senior Spokesperson Kang said, "Does Representative Jang truly not understand why the people cried out with earnest hearts for Yoon Seok-youl's impeachment?" and added, "Instead of healing the hearts of the people wounded by the insurrection, Representative Jang's actions, which deepen those wounds, leave us unable to contain our anger and shock." <<> Regarding Representative Jang's comments that "there is God's plan even in the martial law," Kang said, "What exists in the emergency martial law is not God's plan but the resolute judgment of the people," and "There will never be salvation for the People Power Party, which has betrayed the sovereign people." <<> He continued, "It is deplorable to see the spirit of Jesus, symbolizing love and sacrifice, being misused to justify acts of insurrection," adding, "Representative Jang should reflect on whether he is qualified to appeal for the people's choice." (더불어민주당은 9일 “국민의힘이 ‘윤어게인’으로 회귀하는 것도 모자라 내란으로 상처 입은 국민의 마음마저 짓밟았다”고 비판했다.)
